summary: Implemented `total=None` support for Progress tasks. Changes: rich/progress.py (Task.total and add_task/update typed Optional[float]; remaining and time_remaining return None when total is unknown; completion checks skipped when total is None; BarColumn pulses when total is None; TotalFileSize, MofNComplete and Download columns show "?" instead of failing on int(None)); rich/progress_bar.py (ProgressBar accepts total=None and renders a pulse; percentage_completed returns 0 for a missing total); tests/test_progress.py (new test_task_total_none); CHANGELOG.md (Added entry). Verification: tests/test_progress.py passes 37/37 with the prepared venv. Full suite: 584 passed, 13 failed, 19 skipped (test_pretty.py not collected because the venv lacks the attr module). The same 13 failures occur on the unmodified repo (syntax, markdown, card, traceback tests), so they are pre-existing. Nothing committed.
